decisions.statement: A reading is read off the rows kept beside the day page the reading was filed under.
Where a rows file sits is asked of the name a page's property file is built under.
A day's rows are reached through that day's page rather than by a path built here.
A day's folder is named for that day's date alone.
A span with no reading is answered empty rather than raised.
A row with a metric other than the metric asked for is dropped.
Readings come back oldest first by the instant a reading began.
The day either side of the span is read too.
A span running from one day into the next is answered whole.
Nothing here asks the pages system service.

definition: the readings of one metric over a span of time, oldest first
